preconditions.description: The graph has between 1 and 10^5 vertices and between 1 and 10^5 edges.
The graph is simple, meaning it has no self-loops (edges that connect a vertex to itself) and no multi-edges (multiple edges between the same pair of vertices).
The graph is connected, meaning there is a path between any two vertices.

postconditions.expression: the graph is partitioned into edge-distinct paths of length 2
postconditions.description: The graph is partitioned into pairs of adjacent edges, each edge appearing in exactly one pair, forming paths of length 2.
If a solution exists, output the paths in the specified format. If no solution exists, output 'No solution'.
